items.question: Into what locus does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity dissolve?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
The brahma-aperture is a locus of absorption.
This radiance has gone to absorption there.
items.inference: The radiance situated in the throat-cavity dissolves into the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of gatā with udyotaṃ is contextually interpreted.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the throat-cavity has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.
